about.title: About Me
about.path_description: Specialised in business analysis and change management, I am currently leading the rollout of an information-search solution at the French Ministries of Ecological Transition, adopted by 100% of the 2,500 staff concerned. Comfortable across the full project cycle - requirements gathering, functional specifications, Agile Scrum, KPI tracking - and grounded in the technical side (PHP/Symfony, JavaScript), I connect business teams with technical ones.
about.method_intro: Four principles that come back on every mission, whatever the subject.

listen.title: I start by listening, not by proposing
listen.desc: Before discussing tools or solutions, I spend time with the teams who will actually use them. That is where the real friction sits, rarely in the original specification.

translate.title: I translate in both directions
translate.desc: Business teams and technical teams rarely describe the same problem in the same words. My job is to hold both in one shared document, and to keep it current as the project moves.

reluctant.title: I design for the most reluctant
reluctant.desc: Training built for the people already comfortable with the tool only widens the gap. If the material works for the most resistant person on the team, it works for everyone. That is the subject of my thesis.

adoption.title: A project isn't finished when it ships
adoption.desc: It is finished when it is used. I put adoption indicators in place from the start, to know whether the tool has found its place or whether the support needs another pass.
